name: 143. Compat convert params clamps over-limit max output tokens (gemini fork) (convert params)
description: The compat plugin's should_convert_params (UI: Convert Unsupported Param Values) lowers a token cap above the model's datasheet max_output_tokens to that limit, instead of letting the provider reject it. Red before: Gemini returns 400 for max output tokens 1000000. Green after: the request is clamped to the catalog limit and served. Enabled per request via x-bf-compat so the row does not depend on the profile's compat config.
